build_box2box_transform: build a Box2BoxTransform with custom weights to compute R-CNN box regression deltas between source and target boxes
apply_deltas_to_boxes: apply predicted box regression deltas to transform anchor boxes into predicted bounding boxes using Box2BoxTransform
build_rotated_box_transform: build a Box2BoxTransformRotated to compute deltas including angle rotation for rotated bounding box regression
build_linear_box_transform: build a Box2BoxTransformLinear for FCOS-style box regression using center-to-edge distances instead of deltas
compute_dense_box_regression_loss: compute dense multi-level box regression loss using smooth_l1, giou, diou, or ciou loss types on anchor predictions
